title: CITATION_AUDIT.json - multi-layer citation verification verdict
description: Produced by /citation-audit ('Submission Artifact Emission' section in its SKILL.md), which always emits this artifact - a paper with no .bib or no \cite usage emits NOT_APPLICABLE. Conforms to the assurance-contract.md audit envelope; per-entry ledger lives under details.per_entry. Top-level verdict derived from per-entry verdicts per the decision table. v1.7.4: the top-level verification_depth / layers_verified / layer3_status / layer3_detail fields record which verification layers actually executed, so a Semantic Scholar outage degrades the audit to two layers WITH an explicit disclosure instead of a silent or fabricated 3-layer claim. The fields are optional in the schema for backward compatibility with pre-v1.7.4 artifacts, but mandatory in every new emission per the citation-audit SKILL.md contract.

audited_input_hashes.description: SHA256 of references.bib and every audited .tex file (paper-relative paths).

thread_id.description: Reviewer thread id (present in the skill's own emission example).

verification_depth.description: Audit-level depth actually achieved. '3-layer': Layers 1-2 ran and Layer 3 was available (layer3_status verified or not_required). '2-layer-degraded': Layer 3 was unavailable; entries were checked against arXiv + CrossRef only, and layer3_status records why. 'not_attempted': no verification depth was achieved (NOT_APPLICABLE / BLOCKED / ERROR runs). Mandatory in every emission from v1.7.4 on.

layers_verified.description: The verification layers that actually executed in this audit. A listed layer ran; it does not assert that every entry passed it (per-entry outcomes live in details.per_entry). An empty array is the honest value when verification_depth is not_attempted.

layer3_status.description: Layer 3 (Semantic Scholar) outcome. 'verified': it ran and its verdicts are recorded. 'not_required': Layers 1-2 resolved every entry, so no Layer 3 query was necessary. 'unavailable_rate_limited': HTTP 429 / quota exhausted after the retry budget. 'unavailable_network': timeout / DNS / connection / 5xx after retries. 'unavailable_no_credentials': anonymous access refused and no API key configured. 'unavailable_error': the provider returned an unparseable or error payload. 'not_attempted': the audit never reached Layer 3 (NOT_APPLICABLE / BLOCKED / ERROR).

layer3_detail.description: Raw cause behind a non-verified layer3_status (e.g. 'HTTP 429 from api.semanticscholar.org after 3 attempts'), so the disclosure itself is auditable. Absent or empty only when layer3_status is 'verified' or 'not_required'.

uncited_entries.description: Only with --uncited opt-in; detect-only, never affects the top-level verdict.
